# Formed correction edits an existing successor

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every alphabet: inspecting a site against a reference and exchanging its token for the reference's never increases the defects against a template, for every product, pool and support, exactly when the reference agrees with the template at that site; every scan of such sites never increases them; at a defective site the inspection leaves the reference's token exactly when the pool holds it and the support covers inspection and exchange; a product of the template's length has no defect exactly when it is the template; an exchange keeps every token's count across product and pool. The correction machine is the instance with unit draws: for every state and site the equivalence holds over every copy in progress, the old faithful-scan theorem and the exact single-site criterion are instances, and the old wrong reference that damages a correct product is unfaithful at the inspected site. The product, stock and connections retained from erroneous copying enter the checking/editing process; actual component exchange joins release and subsequent inheritance.

Canonical source: [CopyingCorrection.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/CopyingCorrection.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Positional access, comparison, atomic exchange of reusable components and retained positional bonds are supplied; connection, inspection and exchange each consume one support unit, with site selection and event order supplied.
- Reference matching becomes template correction under faithful correspondence; the general non-increase theorem does not guarantee coverage, sufficient stock or eventual completion.

Materials and connections retained from one copying history form the editing relation; differences are read along the actual route. Faithful does not control operational branches and is only a correspondence premise for correctness.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

27 new theorem declarations / 45 new audits, with 484 inherited declarations separate in 529 actual-closure audits. Two original papers are read at the recorded scope with key-page inspection, without new empirical reanalysis. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Reference selection, fault localization, microscopic comparison/exchange, autonomous repair planning, renewal, error rates and population advantage are not derived; coding, kinetic proofreading and equivalent conventional mechanisms keep comparable standing.

- A shared wrong source can conceal error or damage correct output; budget 13 exhausts editing/release support, while 14 corrects without releasing.
